name: WARNING: Red Lobster Crispy Dragon Shrimp (Spicy Chili Glaze & Fried Breading)
whyItWorks: Hand-battered crispy fried shrimp tossed in a sweet and fiery chili glaze loaded with chili flakes, garlic puree, and high-fructose corn syrup. Deep frying + spicy chili irritation triggers intense burning and loose stools.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Strictly avoid Dragon Shrimp. Choose steamed cocktail shrimp (plain, light cocktail sauce) instead.
